new_terms.definition: A short script that a test writes and starts in place of a real program, for example a fake `mv`.
The fake that `bin/ci/test-generated-output-staging.sh` writes. It stands for a program that generates one build output file.
The two Perfetto daemons. `traced` is the tracing service. `traced_probes` collects kernel events.
The byte `1` that a Perfetto daemon writes to the file descriptor named in `TRACED_NOTIFY_FD` or `TRACED_PROBES_NOTIFY_FD` when it is ready.
The Linux kernel file system that holds the tracing control files. The Perfetto launcher scripts of TRON use `/sys/kernel/tracing`.
One named test function that the `main` function of `t_fuse_sysfs` runs.
A label in square brackets on a test case of Catch2, the C++ test framework of the `t_` test programs. A test run can select or exclude test cases by tag.

notes: All 24 rows are kept. No row is dropped. 19 rows are fixtures and 5 rows are set by hand. Every evidence quote matches its source line without the leading indentation. No quote uses a source line that holds the pipe character. GENERATOR_CONTENT, GENERATOR_FAIL_MARKER, GENERATOR_BARRIER_LABEL, FAKE_TRACEFS and MARK_PARENT: the cells about an unset value were checked with standalone copies of the statements on bash 5.1.16, outside the checkout. HWALLOC_STRESS: the checkout does not hold the Catch2 source. The row says only that `std::stoi` throws. It does not say what the test program prints or returns then. The notes of GEMMA4_PATH, LLAMA3_PATH and MINISTRAL_PATH about the tag `[slow]` have no evidence object. The limit of 4 objects is used up by values, default and effect. The sites are in the change list.
